g.title: Rectangle.308
g.desc: The Secure secondary bootloader can support booting encrypted...
g.text: The Secure secondary bootloader can support booting encrypted and/or signed images. Total number of 5 decryption keys and 5 verification keys are supported

g.title: Sheet.72
g.desc: We’ve updated some software components in Standard SDK 6.0.24...
g.text: We’ve updated some software components in Standard SDK 6.0.24 to support Cybersecurity Mechanism, for example, the mkimage CLI tool. If you're using this SDK for a Bluetooth product, please ensure it meets EU regulatory requirements for wireless devices.In particular, check the new EN 18031-1 and EN 18031-2 cybersecurity standards, which set security requirements under the Radio Equipment Directive (2014/53/EU).Each end product has specific security requirements that must be fully assessed on their own.

g.title: Sheet.73
g.desc: The mkimage tool is used to create single(SUOTA) images. It i...
g.text: The mkimage tool is used to create single(SUOTA) images. It is also used to created multi images (a pair of single images with a product header appended to them that is burned in the external memory to reserve the space needed to support SUOTA)
